prompt: Add bank search to the home screen in the Hajed_car app. Put a small search field above the banks slider (home already loads banks). Typing should call the existing banks endpoint through the repository/cubit, debounce input, ignore stale responses, and update the list. An empty query restores all banks. Add a clear button. Handle loading, empty and error states, and translate all new text.
assertions: Reuses the existing banks repository/endpoint instead of adding a duplicate
A stale-response guard prevents older responses from overwriting newer ones
Cubit does not emit after it is closed
Clearing the field restores the full bank list
Search field sits above the banks slider and updates the existing slider
Refresh/resume keeps the active query and the displayed list consistent
Loading, empty and error states are handled
No API call is made from widget code
All new user-visible strings are localized in both languages
Reuses the core loading/empty/error widgets rather than new lookalikes
No new analyzer issues on the touched paths
